caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: This figure presents three pie charts illustrating the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three categories: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive reasoning. The first chart, titled "Categorical," contains four slices: "Universal Quantifiers" in light blue at 29.07%, "Negation" in orange at 27.91%, "Limiter" in pink at 27.91%, and "Existential Quantifiers" in light green at 15.12%, with the three largest slices being nearly equal in proportion and the Existential Quantifiers slice being notably smaller. The second chart, titled "Approximate Number Generation," is divided into three slices: "Approximate Quantities" in pale yellow at 45.03%, "Comparative Relationships" in light blue at 36.26%, and "Absolute Absence" in light lavender at 18.71%, arranged in descending order of size. The third chart, titled "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," consists of two nearly equal slices: "Conjunctive" in light pink at 50.49% and "Disjunctive" in light purple at 49.51%. All three charts display percentage labels directly inside their respective slices along with category names in bold black text, and none of the charts include a separate legend. No slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the rest of their respective charts.
